text:
maria.k: Quick question — can we temporarily keep the X-Client-IP header in staging request logs for a 48h repro window? Need it to triage rate-limiting false positives.

devon: What exactly would be stored? full IP or hashed?

maria.k: plan was to hash with HMAC-SHA256 keyed by a staging-only secret, store only the hex digest, and rotate/delete after 48h. no raw IP stored. basically `hmac(key, ip)` in the proxy before it hits logs.

zach: +1 on hashed. Please confirm secrets live in staging KMS and not in plain env vars.

olga: Security quick check — hashing reduces linking risk but isn't perfect. We need: 1) KMS key access limited to platform-staging role, 2) retention policy automatically purging those log entries after 48h, 3) access audit for anyone who reads the hashed field.

maria.k: agreed on all three. I can add a retention TTL job and a filtering rule to redact after window. For KMS, i'll open a short-lived grant to proxy service.

devon: small ask — can you add a flag so EU staging disables this by default? We don't want cross-region policy surprises.

maria.k: yes — feature flag `staging.capture_x_client_ip` scoped per-region. default false in eu-west-1.

ops-mentor: if security signs off, i'm fine with a 48h scoped capture but please add a checklist: 1) PR with config + docs, 2) runbook for purge, 3) list of who gets access, 4) post-mortem template if data accidentally leaked.

olga: also require a short ticket in the audit tracker and an allowlist for engineers who can request access.

maria.k: will do. i've started a draft PR, tagging @devon for KMS grant, @zach for logging TTL job. i'll link PR here in ~15m.

security-bot: Incident policy reminder: temporary captures that include hashed PII must be approved by security lead. Please add `security-approval: pending` label on the PR.

zach: quick thumbs — pls include the exact HMAC pseudocode in PR, e.g.:
```
// before logging
const key = KMS.decrypt(ENV.STAGING_HMAC_KEY);
const digest = hmacSha256(key, clientIp);
log.info({ client_ip_hmac: digest, ... });
```

maria.k: noted. i'll include that snippet and the deletion job. tagging @olga for final approval once PR is up. :thumbsup:

olga: thanks — once i see PR and audit ticket i'll give final ok for 48h scoped capture.

maria.k: PR: https://git.redwood/s/staging/proxy/pulls/324 (security-approval: pending)

devon: reviewed KMS bits — looks good to me. :thumbsup:

olga: approving for temporary capture on the condition that TTL job is merged and the audit ticket is created.

maria.k: moving to merge-on-green, will confirm TTL and ticket after CI. thanks all!
